name: Shop-Floor OS
tagline: AI agents plan, robots execute, humans judge.
domain: Fictional car final-assembly hall: incident response and AGV dispatch

meterless_engines.evidence: tests/test_world_model.py ports the spec's 8 conformance checks plus the reference smoke tests

memory: app/engines/playbooks.py: H-MEM-style playbooks learned from incident outcomes (built without the H-MEM spec)
data_platform: Zetaris (four Postgres sources federated as sf_fleet, sf_hr, sf_plant, sf_ops); one federated query per incident
safety: Deterministic critic over OSHA 29 CFR 1910 rule summaries; restraint gate (ACT, SAFE_HOLD, VERIFY, ESCALATE, DO_NOTHING); circuit-breaker safe mode

demo.offline: SAMPLE_MODE=true python -m app.server  (replays recorded Nemotron replies; no keys, no Zetaris)
cases: part_shortage at F30 (critic rejection then retry)

data_sources: See README: synthetic plant anchored on UCI AI4I 2020, OSHA SIR, BLS SOII, Open-Meteo, Bosch CNC, MovingAI MAPF
